source: fresh seed 0 CityEngine via public WASM API; development rate 16; start at tick 0; per-tick snapshots 9200..9400

method.renderer: city.ts roadKit ground road surface is an axis-aligned-in-road-direction box of kind width, endpoint-truncated by clamp((progress-.12)/.88), omitted when fraction < .015; project loop skip predicate checks only same endpoint orientation; shared completed junction pads use open ordinary roads through junctionFootprint. Bridges are excluded because their tops slope.
method.measure: convex XZ polygon intersections of the exact road-box plan footprints; junction coverage is exact junctionFootprint polygon clipping; centerline segment relation is computed independently from original road endpoints; excludes vertical facade/materials and does not model rasterization.

constructionEdgeOverlap.centerlineInterpretation: No centerline intersection; this is edge-only overlap between road-width envelopes. At tick 9200 to 9300, the advancing arterial’s surface footprint grows across the near edge of the local road footprint. The overlap remains after arterial opens.
